text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
On Misogi's suggestion, the intrepid members of Little Lyrical
have come trick-or-treating at a mansion said to be haunted.
Curiosity getting the better of them, they venture inside its open doors...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミソギの提案で幽霊屋敷を訪れた【リトルリリカル】の３人は、
軽い探検のつもりで屋敷の中へと足を踏み入れていた。

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Helloooo? Anybody home?
text_block_list.orig_text:
すみませーん！　
誰かいますかー！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Looks like nobody's here...
Sure is creepy, though. No wonder people say it's haunted.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……やっぱり誰もいないかー
本当に不気味だよね……
幽霊屋敷って感じ。

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: W-well! I think that's enough! Let's go home!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほ、
ほら
もういいでしょ！　
早く帰ろっ！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: What a big house it is...
text_block_list.orig_text: おっきいお家だね～

text_block_list.text: Let's play... Let's play...
text_block_list.orig_text: アソボ……

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! Wh-what was that voice...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひっ！　
い、
いまの、
声……

text_block_list.text: Let's play... Kyoka...
text_block_list.orig_text:
アソボ……
キョウカチャン……

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Wh-why does... it know my name...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんで……
私の名前を……

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: KYOKAAAAAAA!
text_block_list.orig_text: キョウカちゃーーーーーん！！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: AAAAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃーーーーー！！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: ...Pfft. Ahahahah! I knew you were scared!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ぷっ、
あはははー。
やっぱり怖がってるー！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: M-M-Mi... so... gi...! Are you playing pranks [i]again?![/i]
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミ、
ミーソーギー！　
またそうやってイタズラして！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, sorry!
I just knew you'd give me an awesome reaction!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめんごめん。
でもキョウカだったら絶対面白い反応するって思ってさー

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: Um... Hey, Misogi, Kyoka... It's a bit cold in here, huh...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ……
ミソギちゃん、
キョウカちゃん、
ここ、
ちょっぴりさむいね……

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
 ...A-actually, it does feel colder than a minute ago...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？
……
た、
たしかに、
さっきよりさむくなったような？

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Really? I can't tell the difference...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう？　
ミソギ全然分かんないけど──

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Waaagh! Wh-what was that noise...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
わーっ！　
な、
なに？　
いまの音……

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sure a draft just blew something over.
It's an old house, you know.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……き、
きっと
隙間風とかでなにか落ちたんだよ……
古い家だから。

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's gotta be it...
Listen, guys, I'm sorry. Maybe we [i]should[/i] head home!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう、
だよね……
ごめんね二人とも！　
やっぱり帰ろっか！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah...
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
うん……

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: H-hey, Misogi! Don't tap my shoulder! Is this another prank?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょ、
ちょっとミソギ！　
肩叩かないでよ！　
またイタズラ？

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Huh? I didn't touch your shoulder.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
ミソギ、
なにもしてないよ？

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: B-but... I know I just felt...
text_block_list.orig_text:
で、
でも
いまたしかに──

text_block_list.name: Children's Voices
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... Ahaha...
text_block_list.orig_text: あはは……

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: ...Who's there?
text_block_list.orig_text: ……だぁれ？

text_block_list.name: Children's Voices
text_block_list.text:
Trick or treat!
Give us lots of candy, or you get tricked!
text_block_list.orig_text:
トリックオアトリート。
お菓子をくれなきゃ
イタズラするぞ～

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Th-this isn't funny now, Misogi!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
またミソギのイタズラでしょ！？

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: I-it's not me! I didn't say anything, did I?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ち、
違うよ！　
だってミソギ喋ってないじゃん！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Then where did that voice come from?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、
いまの声はどこからしたの！？

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: I don't know!
text_block_list.orig_text: 分かんないよー！！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
H-hey, Kyoka!
...Behind... you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
キョ、
キョウカちゃん！
…………
うしろ……
に……

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Behind... me...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うし、
ろ……？

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRRAAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Ah... Ahhh...!
text_block_list.orig_text: あっ……

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: A-a monster?! Kyoka, run for it, quick!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
魔物！？　
キョウカ、早く逃げて！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Ah... M-my legs gave out... I can't stand up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ……
こ、
腰が抜けて……
立てないよぉ。

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRRAAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Kyoka, look out!
text_block_list.orig_text: キョウカ危ない！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: I'm the big girl here... I've... gotta handle this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミミはおねえちゃんだから、
ミミが……
しっかりしないと！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: Kyoka!
text_block_list.orig_text: キョウカちゃん！！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRRAAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: Aaaaahhhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃーーーーーー！！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Mimi? Mimiiiii!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミミ？　
ミミー！！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Sh-she vanished... Waaahhh!
Mimi just... Mimi just disappeared!
text_block_list.orig_text:
き、
消えちゃった……
うわーん！
ミミが、
ミミがいなくなっちゃったよー！

text_block_list.name: Children's Voices
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... Ahaha...
text_block_list.orig_text: あはは……

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Sh-shut uuuup! Give Mimi back!
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
うるさーい！　
ミミをかえせーーー！！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: I can't take this... *sniff* *sniff*...
text_block_list.orig_text:
もうやだぁ……
ぐすっ、
ぐすっ……

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
S-scratches on the walls? A-as if that's gonna scare us!
C'mon, Kyoka! Stand up! Let's get outta here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
か、
壁に傷が……
そ、
そんなので脅かしても怖くないかんね！
ほらキョウカ！　
立って！　
ここから出よう！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: But... But Mimi's still... *sniff*...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
ミミが……
ひっく……

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
I know, but... what can we do on our own?!
Let's go and find help! Okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
分かってるけど、
ミソギたちだけじゃ無理だよ！
助けを呼んでこよう！　
ね？

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: *sniff*... O-okay...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐすっ……
ん、
分かっ、
た……

text_block_list.name: Children's Voices
text_block_list.text:
Trick or treat!
Give us lots of candy, or you get tricked!
text_block_list.orig_text:
トリックオアトリート。
お菓子をくれなきゃ
イタズラするぞ～

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Again...? Kyoka, let's go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
また……
キョウカ、
行こっ！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Hurry up! Otherwise the ghosts are gonna...
text_block_list.orig_text:
急いで！　
早くしないと幽霊が──

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Why'd the door close?
The others are still inside! What gives?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え……
なんで、
閉まるの？
まだ二人とも中にいるのに！　
どうして！？

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Kyoka! Kyoka!
Wh-what now?! This is all my fault...
text_block_list.orig_text:
キョウカ！　
ど、
どうしよう……
ミソギのせいだ……

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
I know... Mister {0}...!
He'll be able to do something!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだ……
にいちゃんなら……
にいちゃんなら助けてくれるかも！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Hang in there, you guys... I'll be back soon!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……待っててね二人とも……
すぐに助けるから！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Desperate to rescue the trapped Kyoka and vanished Mimi,
Misogi dashed off to find the one person who might be able to help.
text_block_list.orig_text:
幽霊屋敷に閉じ込められたキョウカと消えたミミを助けるため、
ミソギは{0}の元へと向かうのだった。
